scripts.title: J4 Hub
scripts.features:
Welcome to J4 Hub.
J4 Hub is an independent hub created to bring different scripts and features together into one organized and easy-to-use interface. The goal of J4 Hub is to make accessing different scripts simpler, while keeping the hub itself organized and easy to use.
One thing I want everyone to know is that every script included in J4 Hub was made by me, J4KEISCOOLER. Each script was created as its own individual project before being brought together into the hub.
Even though the scripts are all connected through J4 Hub, each one has its own purpose, functionality, and design. I made the individual scripts separately and then added them into J4 Hub so they could all be accessed from one place.
J4 Hub itself is also part of my project. I created the interface, the buttons, the tabs, the animations, the player settings, the credits section, the scrolling Scripts tab, and the overall design of the hub.
The idea behind J4 Hub is simple:
One hub. Multiple scripts. One creator.
Instead of having to use a bunch of separate GUIs, J4 Hub brings everything together into one organized interface. As the hub continues to grow, I can continue creating new scripts and adding more features to it.
Every script inside the hub is something I made myself, and each one can be updated or improved individually while still being part of the larger J4 Hub project.
So, to summarize:
J4 Hub is independent.
Every script inside it was made by me.
Each script was created individually.
The hub brings all of my scripts together in one place.
And the entire project is made by J4KEISCOOLER.
Thank you for checking out J4 Hub, and remember:
One creator. One hub. Multiple scripts.
J4 Hub — Made by J4KEISCOOLER

scripts.title: Autofarm (Christmas Update)
scripts.script:
--Webhook for the script (Optional)
getgenv().WebhookURL = ""
getgenv().ScriptConfig = {
    SellAll = true, -- Set to true unless you want to stop getting items next run
    LockFoodAbove = 5000, -- Automatically Locks/Favorite Food greater than or equal to set number/price
    MinFoodPrice = 20, -- sets the minimum food to pick up, set to 0 to disable
    FloorLimit = 30, -- Max Floor to attempt
    LobbySize = 1, -- self explanatory
    LobbyFriendsOnly = true, -- self explanatory
    PickupAttempts = 5, -- Max amount of times before it gives up picking up the food, recommended lowest is 5
    InteractCooldown = 0.1, -- Cooldown between interaction/pickup, recommended lowest is 0.1
    StatusMenu = true, -- Enables the GUI when in dungeon for cleaner looks, press H to hide or tap the button on top right
    HideFood = 100, -- Hides food in the elevator that are under the value set, set to 0 to disable
    WaitBeforeVote = 0.1, -- Wait for (number) of second/s before voting.
    WalkSpeed = 20, -- Changes walkspeed when on dungeon, can only be modified once.
}
